title: 第11章 临行之前第12章 祝余学院
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
巨狼将戒指递给楚少野，“除了千星之外，这枚黑玉戒也是主人和主母给少主准备的诞辰礼，黑玉戒乃是七阶储物灵器，不仅空间比一般的储物灵器大上许多，还可以存放活物。”
楚少野将戒指接了过来，这黑玉戒虽然是七阶灵器，但外表却朴实无华，一丝灵气波动都没有，看着就像是普通的装饰品。
巨狼道：“少主，黑玉戒和千星一样，都是高阶灵器，您快点滴血认主吧这样就不怕被人抢走了。”
楚少野点了点头，拔出千星将指尖划破，将血液滴在黑玉戒上，黑玉戒吸收了血液，表面泛起一道流光，转而恢复成朴实无华的样子。
巨狼看着戒指，眼神中充满怀念，原本这里面原本还装着很多为少主准备的珍贵物品，可惜都在逃亡的路上用掉了。
楚少野将黑玉戒戴到小拇指上，使用意念查看，戒指中还放着一些婴儿的衣物和用品，想必都是他的父母细心准备的。
楚少野眼眶酸涩，使劲闭了闭眼，才压抑住想哭的冲动。
巨狼蹭了蹭少年的额头，“少主，我还有一些东西要交给你。”
巨狼带着楚少野走到了山洞中的一角，这小小的角落中堆放着上百个五颜六色的灵丹。
灵丹是灵兽的灵气循环中枢，只有天赋高的灵兽才能够孕育出来，并不是每只灵兽都有，二三十只灵兽中，可能只有一只灵兽能够凝结出灵丹。
“这些灵丹是我这些年积攒下来的，虽然品阶不高，但是少主用起来正好。”
楚家村附近连只一阶灵兽都少见，这么多的灵丹，不知道霜月跑了多远，花了多少时间才能攒起来。
楚少野扑进巨狼的毛毛领里，闷声闷气道：“谢谢你，霜月。”
巨狼抬起爪子轻轻在他背上拍了拍，“少主，这是我应该做的。”
楚少野摇摇头，却没有说什么，这哪是霜月应该做的，它早就跟父亲解除了契约，将他交给楚望山夫妇收养已经是仁至义尽，还默默守护了他十二年，怎么能说是应该做的呢？
楚少野将小山一般的灵丹一一放入戒指中，顺便数了数，这堆灵丹共有一阶灵丹一百一十二颗，二阶灵丹二十四颗，三阶灵丹九颗，甚至还有一枚火属性的四阶灵丹。
这是一笔不小的财富，万灵大陆使用的货币为铜币，银币，金币，换算的比率为一百比一，一枚一阶灵丹可以卖出两个银币的价钱，足够楚家村的一户人家花销一年。
巨狼见他收好，“等少主离开后，我也会离开这里。”
楚少野点了点头，他知道巨狼留在这个贫瘠之地都是为了他，巨狼当年受的伤一直没有好全，这里没有能够治疗它的伤的灵药。
楚少野扑到巨狼的身上，“霜月，我舍不得你。”

巨狼的眼睛中闪过笑意，就算少主做事再稳重，也只是个十二岁的孩子啊。
“少主，我们的一生中总会经历很多别离，就像之前我与主人，现在我与你，只要我们心中牵挂着彼此，总有一天会再次相遇的。”
楚少野点点头，巨狼将他送到了洞口，“回去吧少主，还有很多人在等着你。”
楚少野抱着小狐狸一步三回头的离开，巨狼坐在洞口像往日一样看着他离去。
下次再见到少主，不知道会是何年何月。
楚少野回到家时已经是傍晚，院子里有十几个妇人在忙碌，她们都是来楚家帮忙准备酒席的。
妇人们看到他热情的打招呼，“少野回来啦，怀里这个小家伙是你的本命灵兽吧，长的真俊。”
楚少野笑了笑，想要上前帮忙，却被兰芳赶回了屋，“不用你干活，这场酒席就是给你们准备的，等着吃就行了。”
content_en:
The giant wolf handed the ring to Chu Shaoye, "In addition to the thousand stars, this black jade ring is also a birthday gift prepared by the master and mistress for the young master. The black jade ring is a seventh-level spiritual storage weapon. Not only is the space much larger than ordinary storage spiritual weapons, it can also store living objects."
Chu Shaoye took the ring. Although this black jade ring was a seventh-level spiritual weapon, its appearance was simple and unpretentious, without any fluctuations in spiritual energy. It looked like an ordinary decoration.
The giant wolf said: "Young Master, the Black Jade Ring, like the Thousand Stars, is a high-level spiritual weapon. Please hurry up and shed your blood to identify its owner. This way you won't be afraid of being snatched away."
Chu Shaoye nodded, pulled out Qianxing, cut his fingertip, and dripped the blood on the black jade ring. The black jade ring absorbed the blood, and a stream of light appeared on the surface, then returned to its plain and unpretentious appearance.
The giant wolf looked at the ring, his eyes full of nostalgia. It originally contained many precious items prepared for the young master, but unfortunately they were all used on the way to escape.
Chu Shaoye put the black jade ring on his little finger and used his mind to check it. There were also some baby clothes and supplies in the ring, which must have been carefully prepared by his parents.
Chu Shaoye's eyes were sore and he closed them hard before suppressing the urge to cry.
The giant wolf rubbed the young man's forehead, "Young Master, I still have something to give you."
The giant wolf took Chu Shaoye to a corner of the cave. There were hundreds of colorful elixirs piled in this small corner.
Spirit elixir is the spiritual energy circulation center of spirit beasts. Only spirit beasts with high talents can breed it. Not every spirit beast has it. Among twenty or thirty spirit beasts, only one spirit beast may be able to condense the spirit elixir.
"I have accumulated these elixirs over the years. Although they are not of high grade, they are just right for young master to use."
It is rare to see even a first-level spirit beast near Chujia Village. With so many spirit pills, I don’t know how far Shuangyue traveled and how much time it took to accumulate them.
Chu Shaoye threw himself into the giant wolf's fur collar and said in a muffled voice: "Thank you, Shuangyue."
The giant wolf raised its paws and patted his back gently, "Young Master, this is what I should do."
Chu Shaoye shook his head, but didn't say anything. This was not what Shuangyue should do. It had already terminated the contract with his father, and it was the most benevolent thing to give him to Chu Wangshan and his wife for adoption. It also silently protected him for twelve years. How could it be said that it was what it should do?
Chu Shaoye put the small mountain of elixirs into the ring one by one, and counted them. The pile of elixirs had a total of 112 first-level elixirs, twenty-four second-level elixirs, nine third-level elixirs, and even a fourth-level fire-attribute elixir.
This is a considerable amount of wealth. The currencies used in Wanling Continent are copper coins, silver coins, and gold coins. The conversion ratio is one hundred to one. A first-level elixir can be sold for two silver coins, which is enough for a family in Chujia Village to spend for a year.
The giant wolf saw him put it away and said, "After the young master leaves, I will also leave here."
Chu Shaoye nodded. He knew that the giant wolf stayed in this barren land because of him. The injuries suffered by the giant wolf had never fully healed, and there was no elixir here that could cure its injuries.
Chu Shaoye jumped on the giant wolf, "Shuangyue, I can't let you go."
A smile flashed in the giant wolf's eyes. No matter how steady the young master is, he is only a twelve-year-old child.
"Young Master, we will always experience a lot of separation in our lives. Just like Master and I before, and you and me now, as long as we care about each other in our hearts, we will meet again one day."
Chu Shaoye nodded, and the giant wolf sent him to the entrance of the cave, "Go back, young master, there are many people waiting for you."
Chu Shaoye hugged the little fox and left three times, while the giant wolf sat at the entrance of the cave and watched him leave as usual.
I don’t know what year or month it will be when I see the young master next time.
It was already evening when Chu Shaoye returned home, and there were more than a dozen women busy in the yard. They all came to Chu's house to help prepare the banquet.
womanWhen they saw him, they greeted him enthusiastically, "Shaoye is back. This little guy in your arms is your natal spiritual beast, right? He's so handsome."
Chu Shaoye smiled and wanted to step forward to help, but Lan Fang rushed him back to the house. "You don't need to work. This banquet is just for you. Just wait and eat."
